mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM v_user_dept_effective ud WHERE ud.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM v_user_post_effective up WHERE up.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT r.id FROM grant_table gt JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = gt.role_id WHERE gt.subject_type = 'USER' AND gt.subject_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1
AND r.role_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.roleCode}, '%')
AND r.role_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.roleName}, '%')
) t

SELECT DISTINCT r.id, r.role_code, r.role_name, r.status FROM grant_table gt JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = gt.role_id WHERE gt.subject_type = 'USER' AND gt.subject_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1
AND r.role_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.roleCode}, '%')
AND r.role_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.roleName}, '%')
ORDER BY r.role_code

WITH all_role_ids AS ( SELECT DISTINCT r.id AS role_id FROM grant_table gt JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = gt.role_id WHERE gt.subject_type = 'USER' AND gt.subject_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 ) SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT p.id FROM sys_role_permission rp JOIN all_role_ids ar ON rp.role_id = ar.role_id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE p.status = 1
AND p.permission_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.permissionCode}, '%')
AND p.permission_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.permissionName}, '%')
) t

WITH all_role_ids AS ( SELECT DISTINCT r.id AS role_id FROM grant_table gt JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = gt.role_id WHERE gt.subject_type = 'USER' AND gt.subject_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.permission_code, p.permission_name, p.status FROM sys_role_permission rp JOIN all_role_ids ar ON rp.role_id = ar.role_id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE p.status = 1
AND p.permission_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.permissionCode}, '%')
AND p.permission_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.permissionName}, '%')
ORDER BY p.permission_code
